Topic.label: The Concept and Notation of Angles

Question:
Which point is the vertex of \(\angle AOB\)?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_056_q1_question_en.svg)
Solution: When an angle is named using three uppercase letters, the middle letter represents the vertex. Therefore, the vertex of \(\angle AOB\) is point O.
